gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Wide, stocky, and plainly athletic. Tourney cuts every stroke to one width and spaces its words wide, while Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs tight, rope-thick curves beneath it, lowercase oversized next to small capitals.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width, tall and generously spaced, with a vintage look that grabs the eye. Noto Sans Bamum, by contrast, has big counters and curves that stop short.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Vintage, loud, and hard to ignore. Vast Shadow keeps its thickness constant around every curve, while Noto Sans Ethiopic does the quieter work with sturdy lowercase and c terminals hanging far from the bowl.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Tall, spaced, and unmistakably vintage. Vast Shadow holds the top with uniform lines while Noto Sans Gothic takes over below, its big lowercase counters and open-parenthesis curves giving the lines room.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Vintage, and happy to be looked at. Vast Shadow glides on strokes that never change weight, while Noto Sans Tai Tham packs its chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-huninn: Techy, friendly, and generous with space. Zen Dots leaves lots of room around each letter, and Bpmf Huninn brings thin, tubing-like strokes with a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Zen Dots gives every letter plenty of room. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std reads gently paragraph after paragraph, its counters staying open to the outside and its curves swelling just slightly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-marcellus-s: Raw, blunt, and big-bodied. Capture Smallz stays tactical and rough, while Marcellus SC brings a dignified, literary hush, with gently modulated strokes and a lowercase that stands like cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-faustina: Faustina is authoritative, its c open-jawed like a pair of pliers. Beneath the spaced-out play of Early GameBoy, Faustina's bowls thin gently and its capitals barely top the lowercase, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ovo: Cosmic, loose, and drawn like a marker. Galaxy keeps a marker-like constant line up top, while Ovo sits below with modest contrast, a tall middle band and spacious curve endings.
